#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

struct Fraction {
    long long numerator, denominator;
};

pair<long long, long long> get_bounds(int x, int y, int b) {
    long long low = (long long)b * x / y;
    long long high = ((long long)b * x + y - 1) / y;
    return {low, high};
}

long long gcd(long long a, long long b) {
    while (b != 0) {
        long long temp = b;
        b = a % b;
        a = temp;
    }
    return a;
}

void process(int x, int y, int n) {
    vector<Fraction> candidates;
    for (int b = 1; b <= n; ++b) {
        auto bounds = get_bounds(x, y, b);
        candidates.push_back({bounds.first, b});
        candidates.push_back({bounds.second, b});
    }

    auto compare = [&](Fraction f1, Fraction f2) {
        long long a1 = f1.numerator, b1 = f1.denominator;
        long long a2 = f2.numerator, b2 = f2.denominator;
        long long diff1 = abs((long long)x * b1 * b2 - a1 * b2 * y);
        long long diff2 = abs((long long)x * b1 * b2 - a2 * b1 * y);
        if (diff1 != diff2) return diff1 < diff2;
        if (b1 != b2) return b1 < b2;
        return a1 < a2;
    };

    sort(candidates.begin(), candidates.end(), compare);
    cout << candidates.front().numerator << "/" << candidates.front().denominator << "\n";
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;
    process(x, y, n);
    return 0;
}
